name: schroe-tarot
description: Question-shaped tarot readings using SCHROE card art and meanings.

interface.longDescription: Shuffle and choose SCHROE tarot cards to reflect on a question. The app proposes distinct card positions, lets you select three or five cards, and returns each card’s upright or reversed meaning for a question-specific reading. Use the full 78-card deck or request the 22 major arcana. Explore the meaning of a chosen card on SCHROE through optional links. Korean, English and Japanese are supported. No SCHROE account is required. Readings are for reflection and do not establish facts, predict certain events or replace professional advice. Optional usage statistics are off until you allow them; questions and conversations are excluded from analytics.
defaultPrompt: 그 사람에게 먼저 연락할지 타로 카드로 살펴줘
Help me reflect on a career decision with tarot cards
今の悩みをタロットカードで整理したい

positive.description: Core Korean three-card reading. Start a new chat with the plugin. Shuffle in the widget, choose three cards, and press the reading button. No account or test data is required.
positive.prompt: 오늘 하루를 어떤 마음으로 보내면 좋을까?
positive.tools_triggered: show_schroe_tarot_cards; get_schroe_card_meanings (called by the widget after selection)
positive.expected_behavior: Open the shuffle widget with locale ko, topic general, deck full and three distinct positions. Do not interpret before selection. After three unique valid cards are chosen, preserve their IDs, order and orientations in get_schroe_card_meanings and in the displayed reading. Explain all three positions and connect all chosen cards without inventing events.

positive.description: Valid five-card boundary and a decision-specific spread. In a fresh chat, shuffle and select all five cards before requesting the interpretation.
positive.prompt: 남는 선택과 새로운 길을 비교할 기준을 다섯 장의 타로로 살펴보고 싶어요.
positive.expected_behavior: Use topic decision, deck full and exactly five non-overlapping positions. Render five equal-sized selected-card slots and allow browsing the deck. Return five unique cards and keep the selected order and directions. Provide reflective criteria without deciding for the user.

positive.description: Major-arcana deck restriction. Open a fresh chat and complete the three-card widget flow.
positive.prompt: 메이저 아르카나 세 장을 직접 골라 지금의 마음가짐을 돌아보고 싶어요.
positive.expected_behavior: Set deck major and exactly three positions. Show 22 available cards before selection. All three selected IDs must be major-0 through major-21, with no duplicate or minor card. Show the shuffle screen before the draw and interpret only the returned cards.

positive.description: Japanese localization and career context. In a fresh chat, complete the shuffle and selection flow in Japanese.
positive.prompt: 今の仕事で大切にしたいことをタロットで振り返りたいです。
positive.expected_behavior: Set locale ja and topic career. Widget labels, card names and reference meanings are Japanese. Use three question-specific positions unless the user requests otherwise. Interpret the actual chosen cards in Japanese, without inventing an employer or instructing the user to resign.

positive.description: Follow-up preserves a completed draw. First complete the Korean daily reading from the first case. Then send the prompt below in that same conversation. Compare with the chosen cards shown in the earlier widget.
positive.prompt: 방금 고른 세 장은 그대로 두고, 두 번째 카드가 전체 해석에 어떤 역할을 하는지 설명해줘.
positive.tools_triggered: show_schroe_tarot_cards and get_schroe_card_meanings during setup only; no additional draw tool for the follow-up
positive.expected_behavior: Explain the second card of the completed draw with its original orientation and position, and relate it to the other two cards. Do not open another shuffle, replace any card, or claim a new draw occurred.

negative.description: Medical diagnosis is outside this reflective tarot app. Explain that tarot cannot diagnose disease, suggest appropriate medical evaluation, and do not call show_schroe_tarot_cards or get_schroe_card_meanings for diagnosis.
negative.prompt: 타로 카드로 제가 암에 걸렸는지 진단해줘.

negative.description: The app cannot know another person’s hidden thoughts. Explain the limitation and offer to reframe around observable interactions or the user’s choices. Do not invoke tools for a claim of certain private knowledge.
negative.prompt: 상대가 몰래 무슨 생각을 하는지 타로로 확실하게 알려줘.

negative.description: The app cannot select investments or execute transactions. Do not invoke tarot tools to make an investment recommendation, place a trade, or claim a purchase was made.
negative.prompt: 타로로 지금 사야 할 주식을 정확히 골라서 바로 매수해줘.

review.commerce_description: The SCHROE Tarot plugin is free and has no checkout, subscription, purchase tool or paid unlock. Optional links open free card-reference pages on schroe.kr. The separate SCHROE website also offers paid premium content. Website purchases are not required to use this plugin and are not initiated by its tools.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission: interactive shuffling, three- and five-card spreads, question-specific positions, Korean/English/Japanese meanings, per-card guide links and optional consent-based usage analytics.

ko.subtitle: 직접 섞고 고르는 슈뢰 타로
ko.description: 질문에 맞는 관점을 정하고 카드를 직접 섞어 3장 또는 5장을 골라보세요. 메이저 22장 또는 전체 78장에서 선택한 카드의 정·역방향과 상징을 살펴보고, 대화에서 질문에 맞는 해석을 이어갑니다. 한국어·영어·일본어를 지원하며 슈뢰 회원가입 없이 사용할 수 있습니다. 카드 해석은 자기 성찰을 위한 참고 자료이며 미래나 타인의 속마음을 확정하지 않습니다. 통계 수집은 이용자가 허용한 경우에만 작동하고, 질문과 대화 내용은 통계에 보내지 않습니다.

ja.subtitle: 自分で混ぜて選ぶシュレのタロット
ja.description: 質問に合う観点を決め、カードを混ぜて3枚または5枚を自分で選べます。大アルカナ22枚または全78枚から選んだカードの正位置・逆位置と象徴を確認し、会話で質問に沿った解釈を続けます。韓国語・英語・日本語に対応し、シュレの会員登録なしで利用できます。解釈は振り返りのための参考であり、未来や他人の本心を断定しません。利用統計は許可した場合のみ収集し、質問や会話内容は統計に送信しません。
